question: Show patient details for registration number 165881
Show latest visit details
sql: SELECT * FROM fhir_visit_mst WHERE patientid = {patient_id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show billing summary
sql: SELECT bm.* FROM fhir_bill_mst bm WHERE bm.patientid = {patient_id} ORDER BY bm.id DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show detailed billing and services for patient
sql: SELECT bm.id AS bill_id, bm.netamount, bd.rate, bd.quantity, bd.amount, sm.display AS service_name FROM fhir_bill_mst bm JOIN fhir_bill_dtl bd ON bm.id = bd.bill_id JOIN fhir_service_mst sm ON bd.service_id = sm.id WHERE bm.patientid = {patient_id}

question: Show patient allergies
sql: SELECT a.code, a.display, a.display_arb FROM fhir_patient_allergy pa JOIN fhir_allergies_mst a ON pa.allergy_id = a.id WHERE pa.patientid = {patient_id}

question: Show patient prescriptions
sql: SELECT d.display AS drug_name, pd.qty, pd.frequency, pd.duration, pd.instructions FROM fhir_prescription_dtl pd JOIN fhir_drug_mst d ON pd.itemid = d.id WHERE pd.patientid = {patient_id}

question: Show drug sales for patient
sql: SELECT d.display AS drug_name, ds.qty, ds.netamount FROM fhir_drug_sale_mst dsm JOIN fhir_drug_sale_dtl ds ON dsm.drugsaleid = ds.drugsaleid JOIN fhir_drug_mst d ON ds.itemid = d.id WHERE dsm.patientid = {patient_id}

question: Show abnormal lab results
sql: SELECT lm.display AS test_name, lr.result, lr.unit, lr.normal_range FROM fhir_lab_test_result lr JOIN fhir_lab_test_param lp ON lr.test_param_id = lp.id JOIN fhir_lab_test_mst lm ON lp.test_id = lm.id WHERE lr.patientid = {patient_id}

question: Show latest patient vitals
sql: SELECT pv.height, pv.weight, pv.bmi, pv.pulse, pv.respiratoryrate, pv.systolicbp, pv.diastolicbp, pv.temperature FROM fhir_patient_vitals pv WHERE pv.patientid = {patient_id} ORDER BY pv.id DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show recent operations
sql: SELECT * FROM fhir_ot_scheduling_mst WHERE patientid = {patient_id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5
